policy: Unverifiable values are left blank on the site and listed here with the reason and a source link. Flagged items do not block publication.

rows.item: No official or verifiable price archive exists in this repository, so no expected value, ROI or closing-line value can be computed.
rows.why_blank: A model's own fair line is not a market price; comparing it to itself is circular.

links.label: NBA Stats FAQ (no download; no odds product)

rows.resolution: Ingest a licensed historical price feed with timestamps, then re-run gate G9.

rows.item: 96 graded out-of-sample predictions, against a pre-registered requirement of 300.
rows.why_blank: Skill estimates on 96 games have confidence intervals roughly ±0.15 wide.
rows.resolution: Continue grading nightly; the 2026-27 season reaches 300 graded games around mid-December.

rows.item: Expected calibration error is 0.104 against a 0.05 gate, although the reliability slope is 0.90 (inside [0.80, 1.20]).
rows.why_blank: Probabilities are under-confident at the extremes; the gate is not met and no reward is claimed.
rows.resolution: Fit an isotonic or Platt calibration step on a locked holdout and re-test.

rows.item: Estimated home-court advantage is 1.11 points on 121 games. The repository's own 2025-26 table implies 1.725 points per game over 1,225 home games, so the 2026-27 estimate is low but not outlandish.
rows.why_blank: The value is reported as computed and treated as provisional. No long-run league norm is asserted because no official source publishes one; the only comparison offered is internally derived and labelled as such.
rows.resolution: Re-estimate after ~400 games or with multiple seasons of official finals.

rows.item: Prop probabilities use a normal approximation centred on the player's official season average, scaled by a pooled within-player residual standard deviation.
rows.why_blank: Player-specific variance is not estimable: the four players on tonight's slate have 4-6 logged games each.
rows.resolution: Requires player-level logs over a full season, from an official or licensed source.

rows.item: The pooled residual distributions behind the prop bands come from a partner-sourced sample of 92 games (2026-10-20 to 2026-11-01), not from league data.
rows.why_blank: The league does not offer downloadable statistics; the alternative source is flagged as tier-2.
rows.resolution: Replace with licensed play-by-play or official per-player logs.

rows.item: Player-level correlations (PTS/REB, PTS/AST, REB/AST, teammate stacking) are computed from partner-sourced rows, not league-official rows.
rows.why_blank: League box scores are viewable but not downloadable per the FAQ; only the team-market correlations use league-official finals.
rows.resolution: Recompute from licensed box scores; the estimator is already in engine.py.

rows.item: Teammate points correlation is -0.139 (95% CI -0.278 to 0.006, p=0.060, BH q=0.075) — not significant.
rows.why_blank: A negative teammate correlation is the expected usage trade-off, but this sample cannot establish it; the S11 stack strategy is therefore ungraded.
rows.resolution: More games; a full season gives roughly 2,460 team-games and a usable CI.

rows.item: Cross-game legs are priced as independent. A same-day probe gives r=0.184 (p=0.059, q=0.075) between consecutive games' totals, which does not reject independence but does not confirm it either.
rows.why_blank: No verified mechanism for cross-game dependence was found in official material.
rows.resolution: Test with a larger same-day sample; if dependence is real, price cross-game parlays with it.

rows.item: The 11/05 4:00 PM ET report is a point-in-time snapshot; 17 team entries for the 11/06 games read NOT YET SUBMITTED.
rows.why_blank: Statuses change up to tip-off; no later edition was read for this release.
rows.resolution: Read the last pre-tip edition before using any status.

rows.item: The 2025-26 prior-season team table was inherited, not re-read this session.
rows.why_blank: It passes internal checks (30 teams, GP=82 each, plus-minus sums to -0.2) but internal consistency is not external verification.
rows.resolution: Re-transcribe from the official page and diff before the next release.

rows.item: Official season-leader figures are published for only the four players the league displays on each game card.
rows.why_blank: No official per-player season average is published on the pages read for any other player on these two teams.
rows.resolution: Read the official players pages for full rosters if wider prop coverage is required.

rows.item: Starting lineups and minutes projections are unavailable from the pages read.
rows.why_blank: Pre-game official pages show availability status, not lineups.
rows.resolution: Needs an official or licensed lineup feed.

rows.item: S12 (opponent-adjusted props) is specified but not implemented: it needs possession-level pace and defensive data.
rows.why_blank: Pace/possession tables on stats.nba.com are viewable but the FAQ forbids downloading them, and no other official pace product was read.
rows.resolution: Implement only with licensed data; keep the strategy ungraded until then.

rows.item: The league states that a combined PTS+REB+AST statistic is unavailable on its stats site, so a PRA market price must be constructed by the operator.
rows.why_blank: Because operators construct it themselves, settlement rules differ and no single official rule was verified here.
rows.resolution: Verify the specific operator's settlement rules before pricing a PRA market.

rows.item: The overtime column on inherited rows encodes 'not marked OT', not a verified 'no overtime'.
rows.why_blank: The transcription convention is not an independent observation.
rows.resolution: Re-derive from final scores versus regulation expectations if it ever becomes a model input.

rows.item: All league values in this release come from reading publicly displayed pages; the league's FAQ states its stats are not available for download for academic or personal use.
rows.why_blank: The volume here is tiny (121 finals, 30 standings rows, 2 slate entries, 13 availability rows) but the restriction still governs any future automated collection.
rows.resolution: Obtain a licence before any bulk collection; keep the manual-transcription discipline otherwise.

rows.item: No monetary reward is funded or awarded. Reward points are defined but nobody is eligible.
rows.why_blank: Eligibility requires gates G3, G4, G5, G8 and G9 together; three of those fail.
rows.resolution: Rewards activate only after every gate passes; the policy is pre-registered so it cannot be relaxed after the fact.
